Name: Gemariah, Son of Hilkiah
Summary: Gemariah, son of Hilkiah, was one of the two men Zedekiah sent to Babylon carrying Jeremiah's letter to the exiles, telling them to build houses, plant gardens, and seek the city's peace. He is a different man from Gemariah son of Shaphan.
KeyStory: Gemariah son of Hilkiah carried Jeremiah's letter to the captives in Babylon, with its command to seek the peace of the city where God had caused them to be carried captive.
RelatedPeople: Jeremiah; Elasah; Zedekiah, King of Judah
LifeLesson: Carrying an unwelcome letter faithfully is itself an act of obedience.
